The 64-Codon Lookup Table Nucleus, Wobble Harmonics, and Fanless M.2 Silicon
How living genetic triplets and digital 6-input truth tables share one 64-state code—running verified skills on tiny chips and fanless M.2 cards.
[125–176 nJ Board Sensor · 38 ns Cycle · 55.2 °C M.2…

3/3 A sixteen-kilobyte core runs verified skills in nanoseconds from four-dollar microcontrollers to fanless M.2 circuit cards, waking large models only on genuine novelty.
